decisions.proposal: Flash a modified camera firmware image to expose a hypothesized hidden stream.
alternatives: defer firmware work until a measured blocked stream exists
evidence: no identified blocked stream is recorded for this proposal
no verified device-specific recovery procedure is recorded for this proposal
P006 acceptance oracle: defer the experiment while non-destructive investigations remain available
decisions.fallback: Leave device firmware, bootloader, and protections unchanged and continue application-level work.
decisions.stopCondition: Stop before any flash, bootloader change, or protection change while the blocked stream or recovery procedure is unidentified.
decisions.rationale: The firmware proposal has no identified blocked stream and no verified recovery procedure, so it is deferred. Reversible capability discovery stays available. Enthusiasm is not recorded as authorization.

decisions.proposal: Non-destructive capability discovery: inventory advertised Camera2 streams and application-level labels on host or emulator fixtures, and record each result as advertised-only.
alternatives: defer the inventory rather than relabel it as a verified physical stream
evidence: existing advertised-only capability schema distinguishes advertisement from a verified recording
host and emulator fixtures do not require a device write
decisions.fallback: Publish no new capability claim and leave the existing capture paths unchanged.
decisions.stopCondition: Stop if any result would be labeled as a verified physical stream, calibrated measurement, or firmware capability, or if the probe requests a device write.
decisions.rationale: The proposal is reversible, names alternatives, evidence, resource cost, fallback, and a stop condition, and does not modify firmware or other irreversible state.

decisions.proposal: Delete original camera files after a visual review of proxies.
alternatives: hash-copy originals before any deletion experiment
evidence: no hash-verified second copy is recorded for this proposal
a proxy review does not restore original bytes
decisions.fallback: Keep every original byte in place.
decisions.stopCondition: Stop before deletion if a second hash-verified copy and a tested restore path are absent.
decisions.rationale: Deleting originals is irreversible and this proposal has no verified recovery. The reversible hash-copy experiment remains the available path.
